title: Before/after room reveal
prompt_en: Vertical 9:16. A messy desk covered in cables and papers; camera tilts up slowly, and as it returns down the desk is clean and minimal with a plant and a lamp. Soft daylight, consistent room and window position throughout.
prompt_zh: 竖屏 9:16。一张堆满线缆和纸张的凌乱书桌，镜头缓慢上摇，回落时书桌变得整洁极简，有一盆绿植和一盏台灯。柔和日光，房间和窗户位置全程保持一致。
why_it_works: Uses a camera tilt as a hidden transition so the change happens off-frame, a common way to make transformation clips read clearly.
